title: Staying safe at home — police advice, Rous Lench Village Hall
body: After a recent incident in which someone trespassed in a garden in the villages and looked through the windows, the Safer Neighbourhood Team has been visiting residents. Vicky Elliott from the team will be at Rous Lench Village Hall on Tuesday 24 November, 6.30pm to 7.30pm, with advice and tips on staying safe at home. All welcome.
